title: Use your hands for praise, not stain
summary: Hands become holy when they are given to praise and clean work. Let conduct answer before performance does.
takeaway: Let conduct answer before performance does.
lifeApplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.

source.shortMeaning: Hands become holy when they are given to praise and clean work.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next reflexive reach, ask what your hands are serving.

evidence.coreClaim: Hands become holy when they are given to praise and clean work.
evidence.turn: Let speech, sight, hands, and feet become honorable through praise.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before speaking about values again, ask what your treatment of people showed today and choose the cleaner act.
